title: SQL AG failover: ALTER AVAILABILITY GROUP FAILOVER
description: The nexus-cli failover-test verb for the Always On AG: promote a secondary to SYNCHRONOUS_COMMIT, wait SYNCHRONIZED, ALTER AVAILABILITY GROUP FAILOVER on it, measure RTO, then fail back to the FCI + revert async.

observe.what: sqlfci -> sql-ag-rep-1 then back; the RTO timeline

observe.where: a `nexus status sqlserver-ag` during the window
observe.what: the Listener now points at the new primary

whatProves: a planned AG failover promotes a secondary to primary (the Listener follows) and fails back -- the manual-failover path the AG was built for (RTO ~8.2 s).
